title: Joyful Toddler in Walker with Easter Basket, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black-and-white domestic snapshot capturing an exuberant baby or toddler taking early steps in a classic mid-century wheeled baby walker. A woven Easter basket hangs over the front frame, while a plush stuffed rabbit with plaid accents sits on the carpeted floor nearby. The candid indoor scene reflects everyday post-war suburban American family life and early childhood celebrations.
